events.label: Congressional Study Group outer space due regard session

slots.name: session date
slots.sentence: On Dec. 17, 2025, the Congressional Study Group on Foreign Relations and National Security convened in person on Capitol Hill to discuss the evolving international law of outer space operations and the “due regard” principle.

slots.name: session number
slots.sentence: The following is a summary of the 47th session of the Congressional Study Group on Foreign Relations and National Security , a program for congressional staff focused on critically engaging the legal and policy factors that define the role that Congress plays in various aspects of U.S. foreign relations and national security policy.
